title: Product Marketing: Templates Feature Launch
description: Create a launch plan for a new Heidi Templates upgrade feature (easier creation, version history, chat requests).
requirements: 2 launch assets (email, in-app, help center, or talk track)

data.jobToBeDone: Create and maintain templates that clinicians will actually use, without fear of breaking working processes
data.currentFrustration: Creating templates is cumbersome; editing is scary (breaks workflows); no way to learn from past versions or iterate safely
data.positioning: Template Builder: Confident, iterative template management for admins who own clinic workflows.
messagesPillars: Pillar 1: Control - You have full visibility and can revert any change instantly
Pillar 2: Collaboration - Ask for feedback without giving away control (chat requests)
Pillar 3: Confidence - Edit templates without fear of breaking workflows

asset1.subject: You can now edit templates without the fear
asset1.body: Hi [Clinic Name], we heard from your team: editing templates felt risky. We built confidence back in. New: version history, collaborative editing, instant rollback.

asset2.headline: Templates just got smarter
asset2.body: Edit with confidence. Revert instantly. Collaborate safely.

successMetrics: Adoption: % of clinics enabling version history within 14 days
Usage: average templates edited per clinic (trend up = confidence increase)
Support: reduction in 'how do I revert' support tickets

risks.risk: Low feature awareness (admins don't know it exists)
risks.mitigation: In-app notification + email; CS team mentions in check-in calls

risks.risk: Feature too complex for non-technical admins
risks.mitigation: Simple 2-min walkthrough video; offer onboarding call for enterprise customers
